name: TellaTV Downloader
headline: HentaiHaven Downloader: MP4 Video Downloads
short_description: HentaiHaven Downloader is a browser extension for users who want a cleaner way to save supported HentaiHaven videos. It detects video pages in the browser and allows downloads in various qualities, exporting them as MP4 files.
author: serpdownloaders

sections.overview:
HentaiHaven Downloader is a browser extension that enables direct downloading of supported HentaiHaven videos without relying on generic downloader sites or external tools. The extension detects video pages automatically, exposes available quality options, and exports finished downloads as standard MP4 files for easier playback and transfer. Users can initiate downloads through in-page controls, popup workflows, or right-click actions, with all files organized in a dedicated folder. It supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, Whale, and Yandex, requiring only an active browser session to access and save media. The extension includes a free trial with 3 downloads before unlimited access requires a paid license.
